steps.step: a fresh workspace with three Projects, an OWNER and a DEVELOPER
a new Project is NOT_CONFIGURED, and its OWNER may act
a DEVELOPER sees the state but may not act
the retired one-click owner is refused (no self-approved Business)
a DEVELOPER cannot apply for the Project
the OWNER applies: SUBMITTED
it is the ONE Business application, origin DEVELOPER_PROJECT, for THIS Project
the Project reads IN_REVIEW with what is still due
a second application while one is in progress is refused
the Project key reads onboarding IN_REVIEW and the requested @, not the application
a synthetic existing Business issues consent codes from its own session
a code replaced by a newer one is refused
typing the Business's @handle proves nothing
a DEVELOPER cannot connect a Business
a Project with an application in progress cannot also connect one
the OWNER connects the existing Business with its code
Project B now receives into that Business — its name, @handle, verified
the binding names the existing Business: nothing was created
still one wallet for the Business
the spent code is refused to any other Project
BANZADMIN's Business view lists Project B
